issuing_body: Executive Office of the President (White House)

evidence.quote: This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States

implementation_notes: This EO primarily revokes EO 14110 and directs development of a new AI Action Plan within 180 days. It does not establish new safety requirements; rather, it removes prior safety-oriented directives. No safety requirements are imposed by this document. Enforcement is internal to executive branch agencies only.
